items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: His expertise contributed to the success of artists including ... George Harrison ...

ctx.x: Hank Cicalo’s career as a recording engineer has spanned over fifty years. His expertise contributed to the success of artists including Carole King, George Harrison, Tom Scott, Cannonball Adderley and the Monkees. Hank was a first- call engineer for major labels such as Dot Records, A&M, and RCA.
Hank was interviewed via Zoom on April 20, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
